v.t: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Ps 69:9 (48 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Ps 117:1 (23 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).

v.t: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, called to be an apostle (Rom 1:1).
